_comment: Edit this file by hand before each bulletin run -- these are the Key Messages shown on the bulletin's footer. The pipeline never generates these automatically (see build brief: 'Keep the Key Messages block as an editable input, since a human writes those').
messages: Intensify outbreak response and mop-up vaccination in measles hotspots, particularly among zero-dose children.
Strengthen surveillance, sample collection and timely reporting of VPDs.
Ensure complete vaccination and promote routine immunization to prevent VPDs.
Improve AFP surveillance performance in below-benchmark districts.
